svg.title: UML Use Case Diagram - JobPortal BD (implemented functionality only)

g.text: UML Use Case Diagram - JobPortal BD (implemented functionality only)
Forgot / reset is a 3-step flow in the client
Backend VerifyEmail(from="forgot") only checks the code;
Client prompts for a note only when the new
Application documents plus their Cloudinary resume files
Not wrapped in a DB transaction.
